Frequently Asked Questions About Appliance Removal in Bolton, ON

items.q: Q: How much does appliance removal cost in Bolton, Ontario?
a: A: Our Bolton appliance removal pricing is 100% volume-based — you pay based on how much space your items fill in our truck, not by the hour. Prices start at $125 for small loads and single appliances. We provide a free on-site estimate before any work begins. The price you approve is the price you pay — fair, flat and final.

items.q: Q: Do you offer same-day appliance removal in Bolton?
a: A: Yes — same-day pickups are available across all of Bolton including North Hill, South Hill, the downtown core and surrounding Caledon communities like Palgrave, Caledon East and Nobleton. We operate 7 days a week, 6AM to 11PM. Call +1 647 922 5865 to confirm today’s availability.

items.q: Q: Will you remove appliances from basements and upstairs laundry rooms?
a: A: Yes — we remove appliances from exactly where they sit, including basements, upstairs laundry closets, garages and tight utility rooms. Our crew uses dollies, straps and floor protection to navigate stairs and doorways safely, so your home stays untouched.

items.q: Q: Do I need to disconnect the appliance before you arrive?
a: A: Standard plug-in and water hookups (washers, dishwashers, fridges with water lines) we can disconnect on the spot. Gas appliances and hardwired units must be professionally disconnected by a licensed technician before removal — we’ll confirm this when you book so there are no surprises.

items.q: Q: Can you remove just one appliance, like a single fridge?
a: A: Absolutely — single-appliance pickups are one of our most common Bolton jobs. Because pricing is volume-based, one fridge or one washer costs a fraction of a full load. No minimum-load games, no inflated single-item fees.
